name: FINOS TraderX — Simple App - Base Uncontainerized App

nodes.name: Trade Processor
nodes.description: Processes new trades and updates positions.

nodes.name: Database
nodes.description: Persistent account, trade, and position state.

flows.name: F3/F4: Submit & Persist Trade Order
flows.description: Validates account and ticker in trade-service, publishes trade events over messaging transport, and persists trade and position updates.

transitions.description: Trader submits buy/sell ticket in Angular UI.
UI posts trade submission to Trade Service.
Trade Service publishes new trade event.
Trade Processor consumes queued trade event from Trade Feed.
Trade Processor persists trade and upserts position.
